title: Chadran Sir Te Nahi Zakhm Pairan Ch Paray Patharan Khaaran Day
body:
Keevain Turiyan Hosan Bheni Mazloom Diyan Vich Bazaaran Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Raat Nu Jinna Di Amri Da Janaza Utheya
Aakay Jibreel Sada Jinna Day Dar Tay Rukeya
Ohna Mastooran Nu Painday Karnay Pehgaye
Sang Ashraaran Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Kol Sajjad Daiyan Vain Ay Pavay Zainab
Baaj Chadar Day Keevain Shaam Nu Javay Zainab
Veer Ghazi Vi Nahi Lagay Majmay Bachra
Badkirdaran Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Naal Babay Day Jeri Sain Na Bolay Lokon
Baad Zahra Day Rahi Fizza Day Olay Lokon
Allah Janay Keevain Boldi Rahi Hosi
Naal Main Kharan Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Ro Sakina Nay Keya Lokon Na Rat Rowan Deyo
Meray Sajjad Nu Do Ghariyan Zara Sowan Deyo
Koyi Jag Duniya Tay Paish Enj Nahi Honda
Naal Beemaran Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Tang Bazaar Andar Ro Paiyan Phupiyan Maavan
Sar Tey Abid Day Jadon Keetiyan Patharan Chaavan
Rang Tabdeel Hoye Vekhiyan Duniya Nay
Naizay Aswaaran Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Hoya Elaan Yateema Nu Sataya Jaway
Maar Kay Koray Muhari Nu Turaya Jaway
Vain Goonjan Lokon Fatima Jaiyan Day
Vich Bazaaran Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Eho Tauqeer Sada Ro Kay Duahwan Karda
Maavan Behna Da Raway Shala Salamat Parda
Kaho Ameen Tusi Rehn Abaad Sada
Ghar Azaadaran Day
